text: Rescoped by worker-4 after claiming and reading the code: the nonce ring is meaningless before nonces exist — the current consumed_invitations markers are grant-identity hashes (per group, deliberately persistent across rekey pops per docstring, pinned by test_groups_rekey.py:522 and test_groups_mutation_lock.py:126/166/246), NOT per-inviter nonces. Sequencing fix: implement this ring INSIDE .26.2 (the COSE envelope slice introduces the nonce; the ledger keys on it; the rekey-survival-vs-RAM-only tension needs a one-line adjudication from Mark at that point — spec says RAM-only ring, current code deliberately persists markers to survive rekey pops). Released unclaimed; recommend folding into .26.2's acceptance.
